controls.description: A checkpoint whose recorded eval_pair_hash_overlap is non-empty must be rejected.
An empty exclusion set must not pass the exclusion-covers-eval-pair check.
Two different recorded SHA256 values for the same checkpoint path must be reported as a cross-record disagreement.
A seed list containing duplicates must fail seed-identity validation.
Divergent training-dataset manifest hashes across seeds must be reported.
One checkpoint hash reused across two seeds must fail seed-identity validation even when the seeds differ.
A per-seed record whose producer git SHA is UNKNOWN must be surfaced as a downgrade, not silently accepted.
An aggregate whose mean does not match the mean of its own per-seed values must be reported as a disagreement.

principle: Each control mutates exactly one governed property of an otherwise valid record and asserts the pack REJECTS it. A control that fails to detect its own failure is reported BROKEN; none is weakened.
